BiblicalUsage: Kehal is the Aramaic word to be able. Daniel 2:26 has the king asking, art thou able to make known unto me the dream? Daniel 4:18 says all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known the interpretation, but thou art able. Daniel 5:8 says the wise men could not read the writing, and Daniel 5:15 says they could not shew the interpretation of the thing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe able is the word that separates God's servants from the king's wise men: they could not, and Daniel could, because the spirit of the holy gods was in him. I hold that my own ability is nothing until God gives the interpretation.
